violations.text: Burgers are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. Per PIC, new menus are currently being worked on. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Various foods in the walk-in was observed held above 41 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food above 45 was disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Food is served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The walk-in was not in good repair. Technician arrived at time of inspection. Temporary fan was put in unit. Per technician, they will come back around 4 to further provide service. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of bio-film. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
